JYM-GIT-SUBMODULE(1)            Git Manual            JYM-GIT-SUBMODULE(1)

NAME
       jym-git-submodule - Initialize, update or inspect submodules

SYNOPSIS
       jym-git submodule [--quiet] [--cached]
       jym-git submodule [--quiet] add [<options>] [--] <repository> [<path>]
       jym-git submodule [--quiet] update [<options>] [--] [<path>...]

DESCRIPTION
       Inspects, updates and manages submodules.

COMMANDS
       With no arguments, shows the status of the existing submodules.
       Several subcommands are available.

       add
           Add the given repository as a submodule at the given path.

       status
           Show the status of the submodules.

       init
           Initialize the submodules recorded in the index.

       deinit
           Unregister the given submodules.

       update
           Update the registered submodules to match the superproject.

       foreach
           Evaluates a shell command in each checked out submodule.

       sync
           Synchronizes submodules' remote URL configuration.

SEE ALSO
       jym-git-subtree(1)
